digest.component_or_area: configuration access control and ownership enforcement
propositions: An AST-based ownership gate must be implemented to enforce centralized composition and reject direct ambient config/credential reads, environment variable access, and aliased forms below approved seams.
All configuration and credential names must be registered with exactly one owner; unowned new names and glob-based exceptions must be rejected by the gate.
The ownership gate must be wired into both local linting (make lint) and CI workflows with red-proof fixtures covering all prohibited access patterns and unowned registry entries.
Documentation for configuration lifecycle, security, and operator procedures must be generated from authoritative schema and ownership registries and kept in sync with structural gates.

Legacy facades, per-job SSM paths, and migration exceptions must only be removed after behavioral suites pass and bounded canaries succeed with operator-attested evidence; rollback must retain snapshot-envelope compatibility.
